summary: AAP creates self-signed certificates by default; with existing PKI, put certs, keys and the CA cert in the installer directory and set variables: `custom_ca_cert`, controller `web_server_ssl_cert`/`_key` (RPM) or `controller_tls_cert`/`_key` (container), hub `automationhub_ssl_cert`/`_key` or `hub_tls_cert`/`_key`, and database `postgres_ssl_cert` or `postgresql_tls_cert`.
questions: How do I install AAP with my own certificates?
What variable sets a custom CA certificate in AAP?
RPM vs containerized TLS certificate variable names
How do I replace self-signed certificates in AAP?

answer_card.title: User-provided certificate variables
answer_card.answer_md:
| Component | RPM | Containerized |
|---|---|---|
| CA | `custom_ca_cert` | `custom_ca_cert` |
| Controller | `web_server_ssl_cert` / `web_server_ssl_key` | `controller_tls_cert` / `controller_tls_key` |
| Hub | `automationhub_ssl_cert` / `automationhub_ssl_key` | `hub_tls_cert` / `hub_tls_key` |
| Database | `postgres_ssl_cert` | `postgresql_tls_cert` |

Copy the files into the installer directory first.
